data.name: The King of Assassins - The Kingdom
data.detailed_description:
An action RPG game featuring a story mode that unfolds through cutscenes or transitions between levels. The narrative begins with a king who has lost a war and embarks on a long journey of rigorous training to confront his enemies and reclaim his kingdom. Along the way, he must overcome numerous obstacles and challenges, face various enemies and formidable bosses, and encounter allies who provide significant assistance. Players progress through the game by completing missions, ultimately advancing the storyline and fulfilling the king's quest to restore his kingdom.

The area mode features various waves and storms of different enemies, with each wave presenting a unique level of difficulty. There are four distinct arena locations, each offering over 20 waves to progress through. This mode provides the ultimate combat experience within the game, challenging players with diverse scenarios and dynamic battles. 

The game showcases a rich array of visually stunning and diverse environments, enhanced by fluid and highly responsive controls. It provides three distinct difficulty settings—Easy, Medium, and Hard—designed to accommodate players across all proficiency levels. Offering two captivating gameplay modes, Story and Arena, it delivers versatile entertainment experiences. With support for multiple languages, the game ensures accessibility for a global audience. Players have access to an extensive suite of powerful abilities, including ground and air dashes, weak and strong attacks, various weapon styles, climbing, and numerous other dynamic skills, adding depth and excitement to the gameplay.

data.short_description: An action RPG combat game featuring two gameplay modes: Story Mode and Arena Mode. Engage in battles against enemies, bosses, and their allies, complete challenging missions, face relentless waves and storms of adversaries, and undertake various challenges to reclaim your kingdom. Enjoy! the game
